columns.name: student_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the student.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: First name of the student.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Last name of the student.

columns.name: got_B_in_MLT_and_gpa_over3
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student got a B in the course 'Machine Learning Theory' and has a gpa of over 3, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: has_the_highest_intelligence_UG
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student is taking a bachelor's degree and has the highest intelligence among all students; otherwise, set to 0.

columns.name: is_under_supervision_of_most_popular_professor
columns.description: Set to 1 if the student is under the supervision of the most popular professor, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: GPA_based_on_registration
columns.description: The GPA of the student on a 4.0 scale based on the courses the student registered

columns.name: num_courses_taken
columns.description: The number of courses the student has taken, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: prof_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the professor.

columns.name: first_name
columns.description: First name of the professor.

columns.name: last_name
columns.description: Last name of the professor.

columns.name: num_RA
columns.description: The number of research assistants the professor has, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_of_RA_tpg
columns.description: The percentage of the professor's research assistants that are taught postgraduate students

columns.name: num_students_with_the_highest_research_ability
columns.description: The number of students with the highest research ability that the professor has supervised; replace NULL values with 0. Highest research ability refers to the maximum capability value in the entire dataset.

columns.name: has_more_than_average_teaching_ability_and_1_student
columns.description: Set to 1 if the professor has more than the average teaching ability and has more than 1 student, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: num_of_students_high_salary
columns.description: The number of students that have a high salary that the professor has supervised, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: course_id
columns.description: Unique identifier for the course.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the course.

columns.name: credit
columns.description: The credit of the course.

columns.name: num_students_got_A
columns.description: The number of students that got an A in the course, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_of_students_highest_satisfaction_score_for_the_course
columns.description: The percentage of students that have the highest satisfaction score for the course.

columns.name: number_of_students_fail
columns.description: The number of students that failed the course, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: percentage_of_UG
columns.description: The percentage of undergraduate students that took the course.

columns.name: average_satisfying_degree
columns.description: The average satisfying degree of the course.
